[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < Device | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' Device
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKeyA , ... > < Device | 'key' : FreshKeyA , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, ...)) , 'secret' : Secret , ... > $ UserX 'signKey' Cloud | (Device ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, ...)) , 'secret' : Secret , ... > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (Device ; encrypt(Key,Secret)) .
[B4] < UserX | 'signedKey' : nils , ... > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (Device ; SignedKey)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > $ UserX 'bind' Device | (SignedKey)
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : (UserX, TrustedUsers) , ... > if SignedKey == encrypt(Key,Secret) .
[B6] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers) , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, TrustedUsers)) , ... > .
[B7] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, TrustedUsers)) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, TrustedUsers)) , ... > .
